text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring). Though Oguri Cap 
and Super Creek are absent, the field is 
still packed with formidable contenders.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Facing an important step toward becoming 
Umamusume of the Year, Inari One braced 
herself.
